title: Marked-read receipt can omit inbox item IDs
detail: An isolated MCP check marked 50 inbox items read but received 33 IDs. A second unread batch returned zero, and by-ID retrieval worked when given an omitted ID. The compact per-read receipt limit drops identities despite room in the full response. Preserve every identity before allocating space to message text and metadata. Evidence on s-zqrc7w.
